english:
Applying <void Volatile /> 4 times within 5 seconds makes your next <void Void /> hit within 10 seconds release a weakening burst that affects enemies within 8 meters.

The counter has a 3 second cooldown before it can increase again.

Applying <void Weaken /> to an enemy that does not already have it grants 25 <void Void Overshield /> HP for 10+5 seconds.

Only triggers once per source of weaken; for example, a Smoke Bomb does not repeatedly trigger it.

Does not grant the Overshield with Fafnir or <exotic Tractor Cannon />.

source.text:
Upon inflicting Volatile 4 times within 5 seconds of each: 
The next Void Damage Instance within 10 seconds releases a weakening burst, affecting enemies within 8 metres.
Incurs a 3 second cooldown before counter increases again.

Upon inflicting Weaken on a Non-Weakened Enemy:
+25 Void Overshield HP for 10+5 seconds.
Only triggers once per source of weaken. 
Eg: Smoke Bomb won't repeatedly trigger it.

Does not grant Void Overshield with Fafnir or Tractor Cannon.
